verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs say developers can use a synchronous webhook to approve or decline Issuing authorization requests in real time. This is reinforced by mentions of approving/declining transactions and real-time authorization decisioning for agent cards. However, the pack never documents the response time budget or a timeout fallback the developer controls. Missing for 10: documented network time budget/response deadline, documented configurable timeout fallback behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
